Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: Represents a school subject with its associated details.

name.description: Name of the subject (e.g., Math, English).

room.description: The room where the subject is taught.

teacher.description: Name of the teacher for the subject.

isMainSubject.description: Indicates whether the subject is a main subject.

notes.description: Additional notes or information about the subject.

materialsLink.description: Link to online materials for the subject.

definition.description: Stores subject data. The subjectId is used as the document ID.

params.name: subjectId
params.description: The unique identifier of the subject.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to store subject data for the scool app, focusing on simplicity and security. Subjects are stored in a top-level collection. This approach avoids unnecessary nesting, keeps rules simple, and enables efficient querying. The subject id is the document ID, ensuring uniqueness and easy retrieval.
